verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a hosted SaaS API, so a public status page with uptime history and incident postmortems is a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a status page, uptime history, or incident postmortems. The reliability claims and caching notes describe output quality, not published operational transparency.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can check a public status page showing uptime history and past incident postmortems before committing to the service
